Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows a right-sided pneumothorax (indicated by arrows), but Figure 2 reveals extensive new opacification in the right lung. The clinical presentation of sudden worsening with crackles and pain, combined with the radiographic progression to dense consolidation, is most indicative of a bacterial superinfection complicating the underlying COVID-19 pneumonia rather than simple viral progression or isolated pneumothorax.
